concept: Systems Manager Patch Manager: scheduled fleet patching without SSH
tests: How to patch the OS of hundreds of EC2 instances on a schedule and get a compliance report without SSH.
expected: AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager: scheduled patching (maintenance windows, patch baselines) via the SSM agent plus patch compliance reporting. Triggers: "patch operating systems", "hundreds of instances", "on a schedule", "report compliance", "without SSH".
why_not: Inspector finds vulnerabilities but doesn't patch; CloudFormation is provisioning; manual SSH scripts mean overhead and errors.
